title: clients_attrition
summary: A Python project for predicting employee/client attrition, including utility scripts that build and augment tabular training datasets. Its dataset utilities import SDV's single-table synthesizers, fitting a GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and a CTGANSynthesizer (with metadata auto-detected via SDV's Metadata class) to generate synthetic attrition data for augmenting the training set.
